description: This file defines classes for handling POSIX signals via a dispatcher and observer pattern, allowing subscription and notification of signal events.

classes.name: signal_dispatcher
classes.description: Manages a list of signal_observer pointers, allowing attaching, detaching, and notifying observers of signals.

classes.name: signal_observer
classes.description: An observer that subscribes to a signal_dispatcher and executes a callback upon signal reception. It automatically detaches upon destruction.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Adds a signal_observer to the dispatcher's list of observers.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Removes a signal_observer from the dispatcher's list of observers.

methods.name: notify_signal
methods.description: Calls handle_signal on all attached observers, passing the signal number.

methods.name: signal_observer::handle_signal
methods.description: Invokes the callback when a signal is received.
